description: Player profile with summary: ready paragraphs from our data (club, season numbers, form; English, no lang; summary_as_of; absent when not fresh or for a player under 18); position, nationality, birth date, height, team, career and photo link where known; cricket and tennis also Wikidata values (birth date, height, batting or playing hand, bowling style, role, country; cite the attribution); tennis also the ATP/WTA rank, or with vs the head-to-head of two players; soccer also bio: known_as, full_name, short_name, birth_date, age, nationality, position, number, club, market_value_eur (null = not in our data; there are no contract dates), and season_stats: the current season (or season) in every competition we hold statistics for, total and per competition (apps, minutes, goals, assists, cards, shots, rating; null = not in our data; matches_with_stats of team_matches_played says how complete it is); NBA, MLB and NFL players also season_stats: the season line per team from the data provider's team feeds (stats by category as the feed names them; season null for the NBA, whose feed names none, as_of when read); WNBA, NCAA and hockey (NHL, Liiga, SHL, DEL) players the same, summed from our box scores.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

player_id.description: player code (or number) from a squad or lineup

season.description: soccer: season_stats of this season (2025-26, or 2025) instead of the current one

vs.description: tennis: another player's id, for the head-to-head of the two instead

name: get_player
